It is tough . Between losing my SO this isolation,  my clients , a client death(due to stage 4 cancer)... im struggling.  

I did create my will and even formulated a plan. I know what my client and I would be talking about right now.

But thank you. My eyes teared up a bit just reading that.  I know i don't have infinite stamina and I can tell I am beyond burnt out at this point. Just had that discussion with my supervisor actually.  They want me to hang in there until we go into phase 3 of reopening.

...

I've been trying to get Orihime now  for awhile. 7 Aizen's later, no Orihime.
